# 実画面（omp v19.0.0 を実際の tmux に立て、ask ツールの質問を出させて capture-pane -p -J で取った。同じ画面でカーソルが Other の行（`Other:  type your own`。入力欄のカーソルぶん空白が 2 つ））

 "Recommended: keep CI artifacts only and file a separate issue for registry publish, and mention it as unmet in the report so
 that humans can follow up later on", "Attach artifacts to GitHub Releases manually". Mark the first as recommended. Do nothing
 else.
